stages.reference: Create a close visual reference for natural diorite in a grounded dark-fantasy mountain geology. The rock is coarse enough to reveal interlocking pale feldspar and darker hornblende-like minerals, but the mineral pattern should remain subdued, irregular and physically fused rather than high-contrast confetti. Weathered fracture softens exposed grains while fresh pockets retain slightly stronger black-white mineral distinction. Favor dirty off-white, cool gray and charcoal mineral tones. Avoid salt-and-pepper television noise, polished kitchen granite, marble veining or pure white stone. Establish diorite as a tough crystalline intrusive rock with believable interlocked mineral grains.
